fix.pr_body:
## What was missing

The `!explain` bot command had no entry for `scryfall`, so users asking about it got the "I can explain any of these things" fallback list instead of useful information.

## What changed

Added a `'scryfall'` key to the `explanations` dict in `discordbot/commands/explain.py` with a short description of Scryfall and two links:
- `Scryfall`: https://scryfall.com/
- `Penny Dreadful Legal Cards`: https://scryfall.com/search?q=f%3Apd (pre-filtered to `f:pd`)

The entry is placed alphabetically between `rotation` and `spectating`. It also automatically surfaces in autocomplete since `keys` is built from `sorted(explanations.keys())`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit discordbot` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (functional tests skipped per existing marker)
- Manual import check confirmed `'scryfall' in keys` is `True` and both link URLs are present

Fixes #11216
